# scGPT

## Takeaway

scGPT uses gene-expression tokenization and a pretrained transformer for tasks such as annotation, integration and perturbation prediction. The catalog stores a dependency-light manifest so checkpoints can be pinned before a GPU run.

## Input and output

- Input: normalized/tokenized single-cell expression plus a compatible checkpoint.
- Output: embeddings or task-specific predictions with model metadata.
- Record: checkpoint URL, version, SHA256, license, preprocessing and a classical baseline.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02201-0
- Code: https://github.com/bowang-lab/scGPT
- Turnkey entry: python/02_scgpt_embedding_template.py.

## Limitation

Foundation-model performance is task and dataset dependent. Do not treat a checkpoint result as a replacement for a transparent baseline or independent validation.
